title: BAAI-Humanoid/MOSAIC
abstract:
MOSAIC: Bridging the Sim-to-Real Gap in Generalist Humanoid Motion Tracking and Teleoperation with Rapid Residual Adaptation

# MOSAIC Training Code [ ](https://docs.omniverse.nvidia.com/isaacsim/latest/overview.html) [ ](https://isaac-sim.github.io/IsaacLab) [ ](https://docs.python.org/3/whatsnew/3.10.html) [ ](https://releases.ubuntu.com/20.04/) [ ](https://pre-commit.com/) [ ](https://opensource.org/license/apache-2-0) [[Website]](https://baai-humanoid.github.io/MOSAIC/) [[Arxiv]](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2602.08594) [[Dataset]](https://huggingface.co/datasets/BAAI-Humanoid/MOSAIC_Dataset) [[Model]](https://huggingface.co/BAAI-Humanoid/MOSAIC_Model) ## Overview MOSAIC is an open-source system for generalist humanoid motion tracking and whole-body teleoperation across multiple interfaces. It trains a teleoperation-oriented tracker with rewards that emphasize global motion consistency for stable, long-horizon behaviors. To bridge sim-to-real interface gaps, it uses rapid residual adaptation to inject interface-specific corrections while preserving generality. This repo focuses on the teleoperation policy training; for sim-to-sim and sim-to-real deployment, see [RobotBridge](https://github.com/BAAI-Humanoid/RobotBridge). ## Installation - Install Isaac Lab v2.1.0 by following the [installation guide](https://isaac-sim.github.io/IsaacLab/main/source/setup/installation/index.html). We recommend using the conda installation as it simplifies calling Python scripts from the terminal. - Clone this repository separately from the Isaac Lab installation (i.e., outside the `IsaacLab` directory): - Using a Python interpreter that has Isaac Lab installed, install the library and install the algorithm library ## General Training Pipeline ### Motion Preprocessing We store all processed motions locally. >[!abstract] 一句话总结：训练面向遥操作的运动跟踪器，通过强调全局运动一致性的奖励获得稳定长时程行为，再用快速残差适配（rapid residual adaptation）注入接口特定的修正量，在保留通用性的同时弥合仿真到现实的接口差异。


# 一、动机

> 通用人形机器人的运动跟踪与全身遥操作在仿真到现实之间存在接口差异（不同遥操作设备、观测与动作空间的 gap），导致通用策略迁移到真机时性能下降，难以保持长时程稳定行为。


# 二、方法

> 训练面向遥操作的运动跟踪器，通过强调全局运动一致性的奖励获得稳定长时程行为，再用快速残差适配（rapid residual adaptation）注入接口特定的修正量，在保留通用性的同时弥合仿真到现实的接口差异。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 所给材料（标题、摘要与仓库说明）未提供具体量化指标，无法给出数值结果；系统组成上，训练侧基于 Isaac Lab v2.1.0 与 Isaac Sim，部署侧由 RobotBridge 负责 sim-to-sim 与 sim-to-real，并开源了数据集与模型权重。


# 四、对我的启发

> 局限：残差适配依赖接口特定数据，跨接口泛化能力与残差模块的容量/收敛性未在摘要中说明；启发：将「通用跟踪策略 + 轻量接口残差」分层解耦，是低成本适配多种遥操作硬件与真机接口的可复用范式，对跨具身/跨设备迁移有参考价值。
